definitions.explanation: A delivery option where packages are left at the door, in a designated spot, or in a delivery box without requiring a signature or direct handoff.

examples.japanese: {置|お}き{配|はい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please leave it at the door.

examples.japanese: {置|お}き{配|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{玄関前|げんかんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: When I selected leave-at-door delivery, it was left at the front entrance.
On rainy days, packages left at the door can get wet.

notes:
{置|お}き{配|はい} became popular during the COVID-19 pandemic as a contactless delivery option.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {置|お}き{配|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to select leave-at-door delivery)
- {置|お}き{配|はい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to be delivered via leave-at-door)
- {置|お}き{配|はい}⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (leave-at-door delivery location)
